purpose: Optional integration facts only. No foreign binaries, textures, models, animations, or implementation code are included.

findings.fact: The entity registry namespace is duneons, not dungeons or dungeons_content.
findings.evidence: Both NeoForge metadata and DeferredRegister.create in the entity class use duneons.

findings.fact: The file declares GeckoLib as required once and optional twice. The author API has an empty dependency list; the changelog suggests GeckoLib is no longer needed.
findings.decision: Treat the required dependency in the exact NeoForge file as unresolved installation requirement. Do not assume GeckoLib can be omitted. Do not alter the foreign file to remove it.

findings.fact: 250 distinct entity IDs are statically passed to DeferredRegister, with the same namespace and helper method.
findings.limitation: No joint launch or loaded-registry dump was performed. Registration success, attributes, rendering, spawning, persistence, quest integration and multiplayer are not certified.

findings.fact: The list includes projectiles, temporary attack helpers, alternate boss states, scenery and control entities.
findings.limitation: 250 registrations do not mean 250 different creature species or complete Dungeons coverage.

findings.fact: The author project description does not recommend installing the mod on a server.
findings.decision: Keep optional and isolate a future compatibility trial in a fresh test instance. Dungeons Alive must still load without it.

verification.method: javap -p -c of the public author JAR; inspect static initializer string arguments and register(String, EntityType.Builder) forwarding method; correlate optional translation-key presence. No source reimplementation was copied.
commands_executed_by_audit: download exact public JAR to temporary inspection directory
parse and count constant register arguments

integration_next_steps: Choose and pin a GeckoLib build compatible with NeoForge 1.21.1, based on its author metadata.
Start a separate disposable test world with exactly the pinned binaries; preserve the actual loader log and registry dump.
Confirm entity IDs in the loaded registry before adding optional quest targets or summon buttons.
Check dedicated server startup, client rendering, save/reload and duplicate encounter spawns.
Create an explicit catalog-to-external-entity mapping only after visual and behavior review; names alone do not prove a faithful port.
